```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries}

library(ggplot2)# graphs 

```


```{r preparing data}

# charging dataset
data_monitor <- read.csv("DATA/pro/data_all.csv", header= T, sep = ";")
#View(data_monitor)

###### EXCLUDE OBS OTHER THAN V SALVATOR ######
data_monitor = data_monitor[(data_monitor$sp=="V_salva" ) ,]
#View(data_monitor)

###### EXCLUDE OBS WITHOUT FID  ###### 
data_monitor = data_monitor[!is.na(data_monitor$FIDi),]
#View(data_monitor)

###### EXCLUDE OBS WITHOUT SIZE  ###### 
data_monitor = data_monitor[!is.na(data_monitor$size),]
#View(data_monitor)

###### EXCLUDE OBS WITHOUT DISTANCE TO SHELTER  ###### 
data_monitor = data_monitor[!is.na(data_monitor$d_fr_refug),]
#View(data_monitor)

##### ROUND FID FOR DRY SEASON #####

#round to 1 to be coherent with rainy season analyses 
data_monitor[(data_monitor$season=="dry" ) ,]$FIDi = round(data_monitor[(data_monitor$season=="dry" ) ,]$FIDi) # 0.5 is rounded down 

#View(data_monitor)

```

```{r means and standard deviations}

summary(data_monitor[(data_monitor$season== "dry" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 5.5
sd(data_monitor[(data_monitor$season== "dry" ) ,]$FIDi) # sd 4.5

summary(data_monitor[(data_monitor$season== "rainy" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 3.1
sd(data_monitor[(data_monitor$season== "rainy" ) ,]$FIDi) # sd 1.9

```

```{r number of observation per season}

table(data_monitor$season) 

ggplot(data_monitor, aes(x=season)) + 
  geom_bar()

```


```{r Kruskal-Wallis}

kruskal.test(data_monitor$FIDi~as.factor(data_monitor$season), data=data_monitor) #P = 0.0001

```
```{r Plot}

season.colors <- c(dry = "#008837", rainy = "#7b3294") # set the colors 
p = ggplot(data = data_monitor)+ # data
    geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x = season, y = FIDi, color = season))+ # boxplot, variables and color by season
    scale_color_manual(values = season.colors)+ # add the colors 
    theme(legend.position="none", axis.text=element_text(size=14), axis.title=element_text(size=16)) # remove the legend
p = p + labs(x = "Season", # x axis name
    y = "FID (m)", # y axis name 
    title ="") + # no title
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("dry" = "Dry", 
                              "rainy" = "Rainy")) # add caps on the name of the variables 
p

```
